scope: Accept the scientific necessity and fixed design for independent implementation, acquisition and pinning of the SparseGPT author source, and one necessary CPU admission after a separate complete source review.
This review does not accept the current WIP core as source-reviewed, does not authorize a processor/model/QA request, and does not authorize activation or recovery of any closed branch.
findings: The candidate removes FFN connections physically while retaining the original linear dimensions. It is distinct from the closed rank-200 and half-width conditions and from a training-only sparsity mask.

The design addresses a concrete carrier question: whether a fixed smaller starting representation can retain enough initial answer function and whether adapting its retained connections adds useful quality over common q/v adaptation.

Calibration is uniquely defined as eval/no_grad use of the original TRAIN teacher-forcing path with row['answer'], the original EOS/512 target rule, and valid input-token statistics; equality with answers[0] is not assumed, and other references are not concatenated or separately replayed.

The stated 384 calibration requests are 24 block-wise passes over the same 16 current-S1 FIT representatives. The three statistics for each block precede pruning that block, and later blocks see the pruned prefix. This is an explicit schedule, not a claim of exact reproduction of every SparseGPT calibration detail.
The disjoint 16 current-S1 FIT diagnostic representatives use per-QA answer-token mean natural-log NLL including EOS, then QA-equal averaging, with matched parent/compressed input and token digests.
The additive log(2) NLL gate is a prior investment cutoff, not a tolerance for Answer F1 loss, noninferiority, or a guarantee of retained ability.

Frozen and Plastic share one physical CP0 and fixed mask and differ by permission to train retained FFN values. The induced global clipping and common q/v trajectory changes are correctly included in this net intervention.

Designed weight values, uint8 pattern metadata, actual final package bytes and runtime memory are separately accounted for. No dense W, dense residual or full-size mask may remain in the final representation.

Capturing the author structural mask avoids equating numerical nonzero locations with the selected connectivity. Observation-only source changes require mathematical AST equivalence after their removal.
The 3600-second shared initialization and two 7200-second model-run caps total 18000 seconds; failure/interruption/timeout closes this fixed point without automatic recovery.
Prior dense anchors are sealed FIT-only scalar quality anchors, not new same-compute controls; the single new paired comparison is Plastic minus Frozen.

The finalized protocol accounts for 384 calibration plus 32 diagnostic plus 4 compatibility teacher-forced requests in initialization, and 4 short generations; each learning stream has 38 compatibility NLL paths and 38 short generations within its existing cap.

FFN master/FP16 observations measure whether the permitted intervention actually changes retained values; zero changes remain reportable and changes do not establish knowledge content or quality causality.
Cache-path hit/miss counters are separated from native-core bypass request counts and are not presented as all visual-tower calls.
pending_before_any_model_activation: Pin and verify the author revision/source and original source/data/weight dependencies in the independent implementation.
Complete source review of all actual paths, physical packing/reload, structural-mask capture, gradient/state accounting, input semantics and independent watchdogs.
Perform only the single admitted CPU implementation gate after that source review, then obtain a separate readiness/admission decision before activation.
limits: The review does not certify quality, actual rank, measured compression, device efficiency or novelty. SparseGPT and ordinary sparse fine-tuning remain prior tools.
Only current-S1 FIT is available to initialization; no future-task FIT, explored DEV or official TEST may determine the mask or parameters.
The FIT diagnostic is not an independent test set and the explored 100 DEV remain a limited, single-seed screen.
A failure or negative Plastic result closes the specified recipe; it does not prove all sparse carriers or all retained-connection learning ineffective. All Frozen outcomes remain reportable.
The old wide-qv threshold is a prespecified quality investment bar, not a proof that cross-architecture or cross-recipe differences are caused solely by plasticity.

A positive result permits only later necessity assessment; it does not automatically authorize full training/TEST, establish an original framework, or show superiority to the quality-missing fresh PAS reference.
No new source module, Torch, processor, model, tensor, QA, CPU gate, GPU operation, score or bootstrap was executed in this review.
resource_scope: OLD available GPUs may be used and at least one NEW physical GPU must remain free under the human resource instruction; protect other users and valid formal baselines. This is not an automatic experiment authorization.
incremental_review_scope: Protocol additions only: account for existing native/manual compatibility requests and their charged exposures, record initial/final FFN master and actual FP16 layer changes without extra QA/updates, and distinguish cache-path counts from native-core bypass requests. The carrier, data, hyperparameters, quality rules and 18000-second model budget are unchanged.
